figure_viii.inspection: Viewed original320x380 diagram:handle above cup,outer rim and inner bottom circle visible. Shape names/positions from original principal-symbol list;no automatic or independent image recognition claimed.

cases.statement: Kent associates approaching flight with rapid news or an unexpected journey.
Kent associates a stationary aircraft with limited success unless habits change.

apron.name: Apron
apron.definition: Meaning depends on proximity to the consultant.

cases.statement: Kent associates nearby apron with a new friend.
Kent associates distant apron with new work or acquaintances.

acorn.name: Acorn
acorn.definition: Industry,gain,strength and a potentially fruitful short journey;several add a qualification.

cases.statement: Kent associates acorn with health/strength,results of effort and possible gain from a short journey.
Kent adds good fortune and ease for several acorns.

anchor.name: Anchor
anchor.definition: Loyal friends,constancy,wishes and a sailor-specific association.

cases.statement: Kent associates anchor with loyal friends,constancy in love and realised wishes.
Kent calls anchor a safety emblem for a sailor.
Kent gives an achievement account for a musician.

beetle.name: Beetle
beetle.definition: Domestic unrest/disagreement;several add an account about supposed friends.

cases.statement: Kent associates beetle with unrest,household trouble or disagreement.
Kent associates several beetles with risk of slander by supposed friends.

tea_cosy.name: Tea Cosy
tea_cosy.definition: Marital-status alternatives are author conventions,not inferred user circumstances.

cases.statement: Kent gives a possible remaining-single account.
Kent associates this with affection and small domestic comforts for a married consultant.

coal_scoop.name: Coal scoop
coal_scoop.definition: Only a FigureVIII documentary account is supported;do not substitute Coal Scuttle.

cases.statement: FigureVIII groups coal scoop and beetle with domestic worries/cares.

bird.name: Bird flying
bird.definition: Only selected flying-bird cases;other bird species/arrangements not silently substituted.

cases.statement: Kent associates a single flying bird with rapid news.
Kent treats a letter-like mark near a bird flying toward the handle as a received telegram.
Kent treats a letter-like mark near a bird flying away from the handle as a sent telegram.

letter.name: Alphabetic initial
letter.definition: Source letter-size convention;no person or place identified from an initial.

cases.statement: Kent generally associates larger initials with places.
Kent generally associates small initials with people;first,surname or pet-name possibilities remain open.

numeral.name: Numeral
numeral.definition: Only explicit money-quantity pairing is implemented;no date conversion.

cases.statement: Kent treats a numeral beside dots as an amount in a money-related account;actual amount/currency/outcome is not verified.

dots.name: Dots
dots.definition: Only explicit associated-symbol money account;no inference from unlocated dots.

cases.statement: Kent associates dots surrounding a symbol with money in a source-dependent form.

cross.name: Cross
cross.definition: Obstacles/misfortune account with a specific small-bottom qualification.

cases.statement: Kent associates cross with hindrance,sorrow or misfortune.
Kent gives a trifling delay/vexation account for a lone small cross at the bottom.

postal_mark.name: Postal letter mark
postal_mark.definition: ChIII square/oblong postal-letter sign,distinct from an alphabetic initial.
postal_mark.locator: ChIII:initial M with small square/oblong leaf;postal mark near flying bird

zone_convention: bottom_circle/bottom_centre are named subregions of source bottom,retaining FigureVIII circle/centre labels. No numeric boundaries,absolute dates or priority over under-handle present/immediate qualification.
handle_reference: ChII:handle represents consultant,home or current abode when away;directly underneath denotes present/immediate circumstances.

general_qualifiers.size: Relative size and position affect importance;no numeric strength score.
general_qualifiers.clarity: Clear separate symbols are more important than indistinct ones;unclear shape is not a personality assessment.

documentary_saucer.note: Centre consultant;surrounding circle home/near events;more distant circle later;outer rim remote future. Not executable cup zones and not interchangeable.

accounts: Organ/acorn on lower circle:delayed hope/ultimate success account
source_example.limits: Documentary comparison only when explicitly requested;not a generally applicable universal organ/acorn grammar. Dictionary marital/organ alternatives remain separate.

documentary_cases.statement: FigureVIII compares the adjacent lower-circle organ/acorn with delayed hope and eventual success.
The FigureVIII musician-specific professional-success account applies only as a historical comparison to the declared musician context.
FigureVIII central tea cosy is described as compensating small comforts and affection,independently of unprovided marital context.

editorial_conventions: Manual named positions only;no shape/coordinate/prose inference. Adjacency means user-declared association,not computed distance. A supplied neighbor list is complete for that observation;omitted list is unknown. One-sided positive declarations suffice unless contradicted by another supplied complete list.
Symbol/multiplicity/size/motion/context selectors are user declarations;no identity,health or profession inferred. No numeric threshold defines several;user chooses the source quantifier.
Distinct observations are never silently aggregated into multiplicity. Conflicting identity,heading/motion,region or adjacency evidence is retained without rule priority.
